name: SuperGLUE Benchmark
description: SuperGLUE is an advanced multi-task benchmark designed to test general-purpose language understanding across demanding linguistic tasks including multi-sentence reasoning (MultiRC), causal reasoning (COPA), reading comprehension with commonsense (ReCoRD), and word sense disambiguation (WiC). SuperGLUE features a public leaderboard and human performance baselines to measure progress beyond the original GLUE benchmark.

license.name: SuperGLUE Research License Terms
license.notes: SuperGLUE benchmark tasks inherit licenses from underlying constituent corpora, freely accessible for research.

verification.notes: Verified against SuperGLUE official portal and NeurIPS 2019 paper.

citation.paper_title: SuperGLUE: A Stickier Benchmark for General-Purpose Language Understanding Systems

provenance.collection_method: Curated collection of 8 distinct NLP tasks (BoolQ, CB, COPA, MultiRC, ReCoRD, RTE, WiC, WSC) formatted into a unified API and submission evaluation pipeline.
provenance.curation_notes: Each constituent dataset was selected for high human performance paired with persistent difficulty for pre-trained language models.
